summary: WebXR Hand Input Module Level 1 is a Working Draft from the World Wide Web Consortium's Immersive Web Working Group. It extends the WebXR Device API so a web page can read the pose of 25 named joints on each tracked hand, each with a radius, for gesture detection or for drawing a hand model. It covers hand tracking well, including a privacy section that requires user consent and rules for rounding or noising the data, but it leaves sessions, rendering, avatars, networking and everything beyond the hand to other specifications. The poses are all-or-nothing: if part of a hand cannot be seen, the joints are either filled in or no pose is reported for the whole hand. The document itself warns that it is a work in progress and should not be cited as anything else.

coverage.note: This module only exposes tracked hand joint poses to a WebXR session; it defines no avatar mesh or appearance format.
